title: AdsorpQC: An Open-Source Toolkit for Quality-Control, GCMC Burn-in Detection, Isotherm Fitting, and Reproducibility Assessment of Adsorption Simulations
description: An open-source scientific toolkit for rigorous quality assurance, automated GCMC equilibration/burn-in detection, non-linear isotherm model fitting (Langmuir, Dual-site Langmuir, Sips, Toth, Freundlich, BET), Henry coefficient (K_H), isosteric heat of adsorption (q_st), and IAST mixture selectivity with bootstrap confidence intervals.
